name: weeek-mcp-smart
description: WEEEK tasks by name, not IDs — an MCP server
long_description: The only one-click WEEEK MCP server. Create, update, move, and complete WEEEK tasks by passing plain names — project, column, and assignee — instead of hunting down IDs first. Natural-language due dates ("next friday"), a guarded file-attach tool, and a confirm-gated delete.

weeek_api_token.title: WEEEK API Token
weeek_api_token.description: Create one at WEEEK → Settings → API
